newsitem.title: USA: Huntway Partners L.P. exits bankruptcy.
newsitem.headline: Huntway Partners L.P. exits bankruptcy.

text.p: Huntway Partners L.P. said Thursday it emerged from bankruptcy on Monday, December 30, 1996 as its prepackaged plan of reorganization was consummated.
The reorganization and debt restructuring cut Huntway's total debt by about $71 million by the end of September, the company said in a statement.

As of today, total units outstanding increased by 13,706,404 units to 25,342,654 units. As a result the company said it expects to record an extraordinary gain in the fourth quarter of about $61 million plus a contribution to capital of about $8 million net of estimated related costs of about $2 million.

Huntway owns and operates two refineries at Wilmington and Benicia, California, which primarily process California crude oil to produce liquid asphalt for use in road construction and repair. The company's third refinery, at Coolidge, Arizona, has been shut down since 1993.
